reviews.title: Love the Game, New Obstacles and Challenges Please!
reviews.text: Been playing this for many years. Great game. Love the cool retro scenery and the realistic outdoor sounds. However, aside from bug fixes, it’s been quite a while since a meaningful update, so the levels are repetitive. It says this recent update includes new obstacles, but I’ve yet to come across any. Additionally, there haven’t been any new characters or challenges in years. In any case, please keep the awesome retro vibe, the cool outdoor sound effects, and maybe consider adding new obstacles, characters, and challenges.

You can tell everything is centered around forcing the player to view ads to line the devs pockets, sad world we live in.
